name: AngleUnitEnum
description: Enumeration of angle unit values for UI element transformations.

staticFields.label: Degree
staticFields.description: Degree: angle unit in degrees (360 degrees = full circle).

staticFields.label: Gradian
staticFields.description: Gradian: angle unit in gradians (400 gradians = full circle).

staticFields.label: Radian
staticFields.description: Radian: angle unit in radians (2π radians = full circle).

staticFields.label: Turn
staticFields.description: Turn: angle unit in turns (1 turn = full circle).
